prompt: Design a set of tea packaging key visuals for a packaging design proposal, with the concept 'mountain mist folding a sip of tea into a miniature terrain inside a paper box'. The products are a series of high-mountain oolong teas with three different fermentation levels. The visual shows a combination of three elongated drawer boxes and small tins, placed on a grey-white pedestal resembling a rock strata cross-section. The graphics on the boxes are not traditional landscape illustrations but an abstract terrain system composed of tea soup colors, altitude contour lines, and layered mist relationships. The composition uses horizontal display photography with clear foreground, midground, and background layers; the main box faces the camera, while side boxes and tins create structural variety. The background remains mostly low-contrast white space, suitable for packaging proposal presentations. The lighting is soft, side-angled morning mist light, emphasizing paper texture, local silver foil stamping, sealing paper, foil inner bags, and tea leaf textures rather than high contrast. The color system is divided into cold mist grey-green, roasted brown-grey, and pale gold amber by series, but overall it remains low-saturation, restrained, and mature. Material descriptions focus on specialty paper fibers, embossed contour lines, spot UV, aluminum sealing film, brushed metal tin lids, and tea leaf vein patterns. A small amount of dominant Chinese text is needed, including the series name, product name, a very short English identifier, and altitude batch info in the corner, with the text integrated directly into the front packaging system. Applicable for tea brand packaging proposals, retail display renderings, e-commerce packaging showcases, and brand investment materials.

promptZh: 为包装设计方案构思一套茶叶包装主视觉，核心概念为“山雾将一口茶折叠进纸盒中的微缩地形”。产品为 三款不同发酵程度的高山乌龙系列。画面展示了三组细长的抽屉式礼盒与小罐，陈列在如同岩层切面的灰白色基座上。包装图案并非传统的山水插画，而是由茶汤色泽、海拔等高线与雾气层叠组成的抽象地形系统。构图采用横向展示摄影，前、中、后景层次分明。主包装盒正对镜头，侧边盒与小罐形成结构上的错落变化。背景保留大面积低对比度的留白，适合包装提案展示。光线采用柔和的侧向晨雾光，不追求高对比度，而是着重表现纸张压纹、局部烫银、封口贴、锡箔内袋以及茶叶干叶的质感。配色方案根据系列分为冷雾灰绿、焙火褐灰与浅金琥珀色，整体色调需保持低饱和度、克制且成熟。材质重点描述特种纸纤维、压印等高线、局部 UV、封口铝膜、茶罐拉丝金属盖以及茶叶叶脉。画面需包含少量中文为主的文字，包括系列中文名称、单品名称、极简的英文辅助标识以及角落的海拔批次信息。文字应直接融入包装正面的设计系统中。
